name: Call of Water
summary: A shaman sends you to Islen Waterseer beyond Ratchet, where she can teach you the ways of water. Your strength in fire has prepared you to seek her guidance.

sections.title: Toward the Coast
sections.body: The Barrens hold the next step in your elemental training. You have shown strength in fire, and now you are sent to Islen Waterseer, who lives along the coast. Follow the Southfury River south, past Ratchet, and look for a big shark near her home.

faq.answer: Islen Waterseer lives along the coast of the Barrens and can teach you the ways of water.
Islen lives beyond Ratchet along the Barrens coast. Head south along the Southfury River and look for a big shark.

faq.q: Why am I looking for Islen?
faq.answer: You have shown strength in fire, and Islen can teach you the ways of water.

faq.q: What should I look for near Islen?
faq.answer: Look for a big shark near Islen.
